name: Q/C Technologies Inc. Common Stock
summary: Q/C Technologies, Inc. focuses its efforts on pioneering advanced quantum-class photonic computing and developing robust blockchain infrastructure. The company possesses the sole worldwide rights to LightSolver's revolutionary Light-speed Laser Processing Unit (LPU). This innovative optical and laser-driven computing system is engineered specifically for applications within the cryptocurrency sector, offering a substantial energy efficiency improvement of up to 90% while simultaneously outperforming both conventional GPUs and even quantum computing systems.
